basis.governing_question: What strategy should Banco Horizonte follow for its digital channels?

sub_questions.question: How well do Banco Horizonte's digital channels serve its customers and the bank today?
What do customers expect from digital banking channels, and what do peer banks offer?
Which strategic options exist for the digital channels, and how do they compare?
What target strategy and roadmap does the bank need for its digital channels?

work.unit: Interview round with one stakeholder group
Baseline of digital channel usage, journeys and cost to serve

phase_work.why: All three interview groups run in one round, then the channel baseline is built; no archetype applies, so no typical range to check.

work.unit: Customer segment researched on digital banking needs and behavior
Peer banks' digital channels benchmarked on desk data

phase_work.why: The three segments are researched side by side, then peers are benchmarked on desk data; no archetype applies, so no typical range.

work.unit: Options, target strategy and roadmap for the digital channels

phase_work.why: Options, target strategy and roadmap are built in one block, then one sign-off cycle with the client; no archetype applies, so no typical range.

sizing.levers: Running Diagnostic interviews alongside the baseline, and benchmarking peers alongside the customer research, would shorten the engagement most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Assess how Banco Horizonte's digital channels perform today for customers and the bank, and where they fall short.

gate.label: Baseline readout
gate.decision: Which gaps in today's digital channels go forward into the research phase?

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Gather evidence on customer needs and peer bank practice in digital channels for the strategy to build on.

gate.label: Evidence readout
gate.decision: Which customer needs and peer practices should the strategy answer?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the digital channel strategy and roadmap for Banco Horizonte, with the options compared.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the digital channel strategy and roadmap as the final result?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: 15 to 21 weeks is an estimate summed from the three phase estimates; confirm the length before quoting.
Customer segments (3) and interview groups (3) are assumed; each further batch of three segments adds 2 to 3 weeks to Research.
No archetype fits a strategy-only assessment, so phases and sizing come from the work and no typical range was used as a check.
